_comment: Solver hiperparametri za C++ metahevristike — LASTNIK teh nastavitev. Benchmark configi (benchmark/configs/*.json) nosijo SAMO problemske omejitve (blok 'portfolio': cardinality_K, w_min, w_max, risk_parameter); run_benchmark.py ju ob zagonu zlije v optimizer_config. Standalone zagon binarja (./portfolio_optimizer brez argumenta) bere ta file; problemske omejitve tedaj padejo na C++ privzetke (main.cpp: K=10, w_min=0.01, w_max=0.95, risk=0.5).

pso._ref: Cura (2009) Nonlinear Analysis — ω₁,ω₂ ~ U[0,2] vzorčeni v pso.cpp, bere se le alpha

sa._ref: Crama & Schyns (2003) Eur. J. Operational Research

ga._ref: Chang et al. (2000) Computers & Operations Research — steady-state, roulette, uniform crossover
